Vectorized Scoring of Terms Against Multiple Element Sets

terms_ecset_statistics_vectorized.Rd

A vectorized function that calculates enrichment statistics for all terms against a collection of input element sets.

Usage

terms_ecset_statistics_vectorized(object, input_sets, lambda_method = "fast")

# S4 method for class 'ECTermScoring'
terms_ecset_statistics_vectorized(object, input_sets, lambda_method = "fast")

Arguments

object

An ECTermScoring object.

input_sets

An object defining the input element sets. This can be either:

  • A `data.table` with two columns: `set_id` and `element`.

  • A named `list` where names are the set IDs and values are character vectors of elements.

lambda_method

The method for lambda calculation. Only "fast" is supported for this vectorized function.

Value

A named list of `data.table`s. Each name corresponds to an `input_set_id`, and each `data.table` contains the connectedness statistics for all connected terms (see terms_ecset_statistics()).

Details

This function is designed for efficiency when testing many input sets against the term database at once.

Methods (by class)

  • terms_ecset_statistics_vectorized(ECTermScoring): Method for ECTermScoring objects.

Examples

# Load sample data included with the package
library(data.table)
data(sample_ects)

# --- Example 1: Using a data.table as input ---
input_dt <- data.table(
  set_id = c("Set_A", "Set_A", "Set_B"),
  element = c(sample_ects@elements[1], sample_ects@elements[2], sample_ects@elements[3])
)
results_dt <- terms_ecset_statistics_vectorized(sample_ects, input_dt)
print(results_dt$Set_A)

# --- Example 2: Using a named list as input ---
input_list <- list(
  Set_A = c(sample_ects@elements[1], sample_ects@elements[2]),
  Set_B = c(sample_ects@elements[3])
)
results_list <- terms_ecset_statistics_vectorized(sample_ects, input_list)
print(results_list$Set_A)
